## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(fixest)
library(modelsummary)
library(here)
```

`here::here()` always resolves from the folder containing the `.Rproj` file, so
paths work on everybody's machine. Never use `setwd()`.

```{r}
#| label: paths
#| eval: false
raw <- read_csv(here("input", "your-file.csv"))
```

## Descriptive statistics

```{r}
#| label: descriptives
#| eval: false
datasummary_skim(raw)
```

## Estimation

```{r}
#| label: estimation
#| eval: false
m1 <- feols(y ~ x | unit + year, data = raw, cluster = ~unit)
modelsummary(m1, stars = TRUE)
```

## Results

Magnitude, sign, precision, and what would have to be true for a causal reading.
